﻿
5240 The Born In The U.S.A. 12" Single Collection 5-single box set
Label (Cat #): CBS (BRUCE 1)
Format: 4x12" + 7"
Country: UK
Release date (Original year): 1985 (1985)
I have 2 copies | |
edit item
Record 1: "Dancing In The Dark" (catalogue # CBS TA 4436)
A1- DANCING IN THE DARK [Extended Remix]
B1- PINK CADILLAC

Record 2: "Cover Me" (catalogue # CBS QTA 4662)
A1- COVER ME [Undercover Mix]
A2- COVER ME [Dub]
A3- SHUT OUT THE LIGHT
B1- DANCING IN THE DARK [Dub]
B2- JERSEY GIRL [Live]

Record 3: "I'm On Fire" (catalogue # CBS TA 6342)
A1- I'M ON FIRE
A2- ROSALITA (COME OUT TONIGHT)
B1- BORN IN THE U.S.A. [The Freedom Mix]
B2- JOHNNY BYE BYE

Record 4: "Glory Days" (catalogue # CBS TA 6375)
A1- GLORY DAYS
A2- STAND ON IT
B1- SHERRY DARLING
B2- RACING IN THE STREET

Record 5: "I'm Goin' Down" (catalogue # CBS A 6561)
A1- I'M GOIN' DOWN
B1- JANEY, DON'T YOU LOSE HEART


UK-only box set limited to 10,000 copies. Includes four 12-inch EP's and a 7-inch single, plus a poster.
